usedFor: Zoho Forms collects answers, and “New Form Submission” starts a run whenever someone submits.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Submission” in Zoho Forms, then “Add Content to Page” in Notion
bestTemplate.why: Each submission can be added to a page, so answers are kept in one place.

watchOut: Anything sent to the person who submitted waits in Needs you for approval.
